postal_system.assignment_rule: A pinned Correos licensed row or other current operator evidence establishes a full ADNNN allocation. UPU syntax, examples, or the parish-coded structure do not establish that every structurally valid value is allocated.
postal_system.perimeter_rule: The parish component is not by itself an official full-code polygon. A licensed Correos polygon is authoritative only when its contract and product manifest expressly cover Andorra; otherwise a surface is derived from rights-cleared address membership and remains explicitly derived.
postal_system.address_rule: The Govern d'Andorra Urban Guide can locate postal addresses, but interactive search or viewing does not establish bulk extraction, retention, or redistribution rights.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires the same authoritative address/building identifier or a reviewed explicit crosswalk. Topographic building shapes, address points, POIs, containment, and proximity remain candidates.
postal_system.administrative_rule: IDE Andorra parish boundaries supply administrative context and optional clipping only; they do not create full-code postal membership without postal evidence.
postal_system.territory_rule: Postal assignment never determines sovereignty or a legal boundary. Country and border-feature classification must cite a separately pinned boundary authority, policy, and vintage; routing, language, parish names, or proximity never assign AD identity.

temporal_model.valid_time: Postal, address, building, parish-boundary, and topographic validity when supplied by the source.
temporal_model.known_time: Source publication, capture, ingest, correction, contract, and release timestamps retained independently.
temporal_model.history_rule: Later postal or government evidence appends a versioned assertion and never silently rewrites an earlier release.

quality_gates.pass: Each full code references a pinned current operator result or licensed Correos row and retains operator scope, parish or locality, product edition, capture time, rights, and digest.

Every official polygon proves Andorra coverage in its product contract; every derived surface retains member addresses, method, boundary clips, omissions, uncertainty, rights, and digest and is never labelled official.
Each address assertion retains Urban Guide or other competent authority provenance, hierarchy, status, coordinate provenance, release, access terms, and permitted public fields.
An exact building has a common authoritative address/building identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk; topographic shape, containment, and proximity are candidate-only.
Each IDE Andorra layer retains producer, coverage, vintage, CRS, conditions of use, and digest; no border gap is assigned AD identity by postal proximity.
No addressee, resident, owner, tenant, occupant, phone, credential, cadastral-right, tax, or protected register field is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights, operator scope, coverage, and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned rights-cleared snapshots reproduce experimental packs with complete lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, operator-scope, and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
